stalls.summaryZh: 旗山知名老店，豬心切得薄嫩、湯頭清甜；為固定店面，請確認營業時間。
stalls.summaryEn: Famous Qishan shop with thin, tender pork heart in a clean broth; it is a fixed shopfront, so check its hours.

sources.title: 食尚玩家：高雄夜市27間攻略

stalls.summaryZh: 簡單的古早味豆花，逛完夜市來碗收尾。
stalls.summaryEn: Simple old-style tofu pudding to finish a market visit.

sources.title: 食尚玩家：高雄夜市27間攻略

stalls.summaryZh: 部落客實際品嚐的臭豆腐攤，切四塊、配泡菜。
stalls.summaryEn: A blogger-tested stinky tofu stall, served in four pieces with pickled cabbage.

sources.title: 吃心絕對：旗山夜市 星期二、六營業
